tree: How can customers book appointments online?
Online booking software gives customers a booking page where they pick a service, a staff member and a free time slot. The booking is confirmed straight away and lands on your calendar.
Customers wait for a call back to book, and many give up before they get a time.
Customers book themselves any time, and you see each booking in your calendar right away.
Online booking software turns visits into confirmed appointments.
From selecting a service to getting a confirmation, the entire process takes just a few steps.
Set your business hours, staff availability, service durations, buffer times, and blocked dates. Keep your calendar organized and always up to date.
Give your customers a clean, easy-to-use booking page that works perfectly on desktop and mobile.
View, manage and update all your bookings in one place. See the latest status, assigned staff and next actions.
Configure the key settings to match your business needs.
Allow customers to cancel up to 24 hours before the appointment.
Set how far in advance customers can book.
Add time between appointments to avoid overbooking.
Let customers choose a specific staff member.
Allow customers to book recurring appointments.
Perfect for any business that relies on appointments.
Everything you need to know about Online Booking in Noxtill.
Give customers a simpler way to book.
Create your online booking page and start accepting appointments today.
